prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” lawyer for every truck accident—what matters is finding an experienced Dallas attorney who fits your case, communicates well, and has a proven record handling commercial truck claims. I can help you find options, but here’s a practical guide so you can pick the right lawyer quickly.

What to look for
- Substantial trucking experience: handled multiple truck/CMV cases (not just car wrecks).  
- Trial experience and verdicts/settlements in truck cases. Trucking insurers often require lawyers who will actually try cases.  
- Knowledge of federal/state trucking regs (FMCSA rules: hours-of-service, logbooks, maintenance).  
- Use of experts (accident reconstruction, medical, vocational, trucking safety).  
- Resources to investigate (engine data, ELD/black box, carrier safety records).  
- Good client reviews and peer ratings (Martindale-Hubbell, State Bar discipline check).  
- Contingency fee practice (you pay only if they recover money) and clear fee/cost policy.  
- Board certification in Personal Injury Trial Law (if available) is a plus.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many truck accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- Have you handled cases against large carriers and trucking insurers? What were the results?  
- Do you use accident reconstruction and other experts? Who pays their fees?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (partner, associate, paralegal)?  
- What percentage is your contingency fee? Any additional costs I’d owe?  
- What is your strategy and likely timeline?  
- Can you provide references from past clients?

Important facts to know/do now
- Statute of limitations in Texas: generally 2 years from the date of the crash. Act quickly.  
- Preserve evidence: photos, vehicle damage, medical records, contact info for witnesses, police report number, truck/driver info, employer/carrier/insurer info. Don’t give recorded statements to insurers without your attorney.  
- Commercial carriers have higher insurance limits and complex coverages—experience matters.

If you want, I can:
- Find highly rated Dallas truck-accident attorneys near your ZIP code, or  
- Evaluate a shortlist of lawyers you’re considering, or  
- Help draft the questions to ask during your consultation.

Tell me your ZIP code or whether you want me to list top-rated firms/attorneys in Dallas and I’ll pull a targeted list.
